title: SearchJev: A Calibrated System-1 Model for Search Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.05107v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Search agents repeatedly make short decisions about relevance, evidence sufficiency, and search actions. Using generative language models for these decisions introduces latency and unreliable confidence. We present SearchJev, a calibrated System-1 model that separates search decisions from System-2 reasoning and generation. Given a search state and a decision schema, SearchJev scores legal options without autoregressive output generation. We propose Soft-Label Learning for Calibrated Decisions (SLCD) to learn decision probabilities from uncertain supervision and improve the reliability of decision confidence. In a dual-system search agent, SearchJev handles short decisions and delegates uncertain judgments to System 2, which retains planning, query generation, and answer composition. translated_title: SearchJev：面向搜索代理的校准化System-1模型
translated_abstract: 搜索代理需要反复就相关性、证据充分性和搜索动作做出短决策。使用生成式语言模型进行这些决策会引入延迟和不可靠的置信度。我们提出SearchJev，一个校准化的System-1模型，将搜索决策与System-2推理和生成相分离。给定搜索状态和决策模式，SearchJev无需自回归输出生成即可对合法选项进行评分。我们提出了用于校准决策的软标签学习，从不确定的监督中学习决策概率，并提高决策置信度的可靠性。在双系统搜索代理中，SearchJev处理短决策，并将不确定的判断委托给System 2，后者保留规划、查询生成和答案组合等能力。我们还引入了SearchDecision-Bench，一个统一六种搜索决策类型用于训练和评估的基准。在SearchDecision-Bench上……
tldr: SearchJev提出一个无需自回归生成的校准化System-1模型，将搜索代理的短决策与System-2推理分离，并通过软标签学习（SLCD）从不确定监督中提升决策置信度的可靠性。
en_tdlr: SearchJev proposes a calibrated System-1 model that decouples short search decisions from System-2 reasoning without autoregressive generation, improving decision confidence reliability via Soft-Label Learning (SLCD) from uncertain supervision.
